items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Badu Ali said he was the one

ctx.x: That's right. I introduced Chick Webb to Ella and his wife, see. And I told him all you have to do is buy some clothes and get a hairdresser and she'll do the rest.
Sure enough, Ella Fitzgerald started out, and Badu Ali said he was the one, and I'd say, shuh, I used to give Ella money to buy some you know, food with, because

she had, you know, just a little orphan kid. And then we went from there, we only stayed at the Harlem Opera House for about two months, and then we moved into the Apollo Theatre, and the Amateur Hour was still on, and Earl Hines was the bandleader of the week, and I said to Earl, hey, we got a kid here, Sarah Vaughn, and she's great.
